children.name: Psilotum × complanatum
children.description: The native range of this species is Hawaiian Is., Mexico to Trop. America. It is a epiphyte or lithophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Psilotum flaccidum
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico to Trop. America, W. Indian Ocean, Trop. Asia to Pacific. It is a epiphyte or lithophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Psilotum nudum
children.description: Psilotum nudum, the whisk fern, is a species of fern in the order Psilotales.

children.name: Tmesipteris elongata
children.description: Tmesipteris elongata is a fern endemic to south eastern Australia and New Zealand.

children.name: Tmesipteris horomaka
children.description: Tmesipteris horomaka, commonly known as the Banks Peninsula fork fern, is a fern ally endemic to New Zealand.

children.name: Tmesipteris lanceolata
children.description: The native range of this species is Philippines, Sulawesi, New Zealand, Kermadec Is., New Caledonia. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Tmesipteris norfolkensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Norfolk I.. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Tmesipteris oblanceolata
children.description: The native range of this species is Vanuatu to New Caledonia. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Tmesipteris obliqua
children.description: Tmesipteris obliqua, more commonly known as the long fork-fern or common fork-fern, is a weeping, epiphytic fern ally with narrow unbranched leafy stems.

children.name: Tmesipteris oblongifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is Vanuatu. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Tmesipteris ovata
children.description: Tmesipteris ovata is a fern ally endemic to eastern Australia.

children.name: Tmesipteris parva
children.description: Tmesipteris parva is a fern ally endemic to eastern Australia.

children.name: Tmesipteris sigmatifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is New Zealand, New Caledonia. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Tmesipteris solomonensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Philippines (Luzon), Solomon Is., Vanuatu, Society Is. (Tahiti), Marquesas. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Tmesipteris tannensis
children.description: Tmesipteris tannensis is a fern ally endemic to New Zealand.

children.name: Tmesipteris truncata
children.description: Tmesipteris truncata (aka Tmesipteris oblanceolata) is a fern endemic to eastern Australia.

children.name: Tmesipteris vieillardii
children.description: The native range of this species is New Caledonia. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
